subject: Leadership summary and procurement path — Helixa Therapeutics discovery
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixa.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@helixa.com>
Cc: procurement@helixa.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: today's discovery + next steps

Hi Priya / Michael —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed path to get Helixa to a procurement-ready state:overview of what we heard

Pain points (what you confirmed)
- Model latency and throughput are inconsistent across inference loads (spikes during batch-run windows driving timeouts in your patient-matching service).
- Per-token cost is high for current embedding-heavy workloads, particularly when batch sizes are small.
- Data residency and auditability requirements for clinical PII mean you need private deployment or strict VPC controls.

Business goals
- Consolidate patient-matching and notes-search onto a single inference pipeline with 99th percentile latency <300ms for queries under 512 tokens.
- Reduce embedding cost by 30–40% through batching/quantization and caching.
- Meet SOC 2 and data residency requirements for EU-hosted data; retention and audit logs required for 2 years.

Risks / blockers we heard
- Security evidence (SOC 2 report, architecture diagrams) and an approved procurement PO are gating legal review.
- Procurement timeline is tight given your Q4 budget cadence.
- Potential redlines in SLA around uptime and incident MTTR.

Proposed procurement path (next 4 weeks)
1) We’ll provide a short security packet and architecture diagram (attached). Rafael to deliver by EOD Wed 4 Nov.
2) Technical POC: 2-week sandbox with dedicated capacity -> demo benchmarks and cost model. Target start 11 Nov pending PO.
3) Legal / Procurement: exchange draft SOW and MOPA (we’ve attached a draft SLA). Procurement to review; we’ll support redline calls.
4) Executive concurrence: recommend a 20-minute sponsor briefing with your CTO + VP Product the week of 23 Nov to lock budget.

Immediate asks
- Priya: confirm the list of compliance artifacts your legal team needs (SOC 2 Type II, encryption certs, data flow diagrams).
- Michael / procurement: can you confirm whether an initial PO for the sandbox is feasible before 11 Nov? If not, what timing works?

Attachments: redwood-security-overview.pdf, draft-mopa-sla.docx

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the security packet shortly.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Dr. Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixa.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@helixa.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up: today's discovery + next steps

Rafael —

Thanks for the thorough recap. A few clarifications from our side:
- Security packet: we need SOC 2 Type II report, encryption-at-rest keys overview (KMS/HSM), and an architecture diagram showing where PHI touches your stack.
- Procurement: we can likely issue a limited PO for the sandbox but need approval from finance. I’ll push to get confirmation by EOD Fri 6 Nov.
- Exec briefing: the CTO is in Asia the week of 23 Nov; earlier is better. Can we aim for week of 16 Nov for a short sponsor sync?

Also, a question on the POC: will dedicated capacity be required to hit the latency target, or can we validate with a hosted dedicated sandbox? Need rough cost estimate for a 2-week run for budgeting.

I’ll loop in procurement once I have clarity.

—Priya
Dr. Priya Shah
VP Clinical Data Science | Helixa Therapeutics
priya.shah@helixa.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up: today's discovery + next steps

Looping in Ben for pricing and POC sizing. Rafael — quick notes on our side for the exec/finance playbook:

- POC packaging: we should propose a fixed-cost sandbox SKU (2-week duration) that includes dedicated capacity with throttled quotas. This simplifies procurement (one PO line) and gives deterministic billing for finance.
- Cost ballpark: for the requested perf envelope (99th <300ms for <512 tokens) estimate ~ $9k–$14k for a 2-week dedicated sandbox depending on instance sizing and burst policy. Ben: please confirm and I’ll finalize the number.
- Security docs: prioritize SOC 2 summary + architecture diagram. We can provide a tailored appendix describing our VPC/on-prem options for PHI. Rafael — I’ll draft the sponsor briefing slide (one pager) once we have confirmation on PO timing.

Escalation pathway suggestion: if we don’t get PO by 11 Nov, escalate to the Helixa CFO (introduced by Priya) and offer a 7-day rolling trial to avoid slipping timeline.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Strategy | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixa.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@helixa.com>, procurement@helixa.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership synthesis + proposed decision path (action items & owners)

Priya / Michael / procurement —

Appreciate the quick turnaround this week. Below is the leadership-facing synthesis we propose you share with your CTO/CFO ahead of the sponsor sync. I’ve kept it one page for an executive read.

Executive summary (one-liner)
Helixa can achieve its patient-matching and notes-search performance and cost targets by adopting a Redwood Dedicated sandbox for the POC, followed by a staged rollout to private deployment for PHI-sensitive workloads.

Top business outcomes
- Performance: validated path to meet 99th-percentile latency <300ms for 512-token queries.
- Cost: expected embedding cost reduction of 30–40% via batching, prefix caching, and a recommended quantized model.
- Compliance: clear deployment options to keep PHI in-scope (VPC + audit logs + KMS).

Key risks and mitigations
- Legal & evidence: mitigation = provide SOC 2 Type II, architecture diagram, and an NDA/addendum if required. (Attachment: redwood-security-overview.pdf)
- Procurement delay: mitigation = fixed-cost sandbox PO to simplify approval; fallback = 7-day rolling trial to keep momentum.
- SLA redlines: mitigation = limit initial commitment to sandbox period; negotiate enterprise SLA for production rollout.

Decision path & timeline (recommended)
- By EOD 06 Nov: procurement to confirm sandbox PO approval (Priya to coordinate).
- Week of 09 Nov: Redwood delivers sandbox + initial benchmark scripts.
- Week of 16 Nov: 20-min sponsor briefing with CTO + VP Product (aim to lock budget).
- By 30 Nov: complete legal SOW and finalize production SLA.

Action items (owner — due)
- Procurement: confirm PO for 2-week sandbox (procurement@helixa.com) — due 2026-11-06
- Priya Shah: confirm compliance evidence list and exec availability — due 2026-11-06
- Rafael Mendes: deliver security packet + architecture diagram (attached) — delivered 2026-11-04
- Ben Carter: send final 2-week sandbox quote and cost model — due 2026-11-08
- Marissa Cole: prepare one-page sponsor slide for exec sync — due 2026-11-12

If any of the above timelines are infeasible, flag now and we’ll adjust. If procurement cannot issue a PO by 11 Nov we’ll use the escalation path (CFO intro + 7-day trial) to avoid losing Q4 momentum.

Attachments: redwood-security-overview.pdf, helixa-cost-model.xlsx, draft-mopa-sla.docx

Thanks all — looking forward to next steps.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
